name: Somchai Chaiyawat
bio:
Somchai Chaiyawat's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for the intricate workings of engines. Growing up in Bangkok, he spent hours tinkering with his father's motorcycle, developing a deep understanding of mechanical systems. After completing his engineering degree at Chulalongkorn University, he pursued his passion by joining a small racing team in the local Thai motorsport scene, quickly rising through the ranks due to his sharp analytical skills and dedication.

Somchai's approach to race engineering is rooted in a meticulous analysis of data, coupled with a strong emphasis on driver feedback. He believes in fostering open communication within the team, ensuring everyone is aligned towards a common goal. Known for his calm demeanor under pressure, Somchai has a knack for identifying subtle areas for improvement that can make a significant difference on the track. He prides himself on his adaptability, readily embracing new technologies and strategies to optimize performance.

Having spent several years honing his skills in various racing series, Somchai brings a wealth of experience and a unique perspective to JOTA Sport. He is driven by a relentless pursuit of excellence and a desire to contribute to the team's success at the highest levels of motorsport.
